text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Day. <chrname> and I were visiting 
the mochi-pounding area tucked away in the 
shrine grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Humans and horsegirls join forces to pound 
mochi. 
It's an event held to deepen bonds and 
pray for good health.
choice_data_list: (I should share some with Azuma later.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the Shuntaisai Executive 
Office, Azuma 
was surrounded by a crowd of people who 
adored her.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident
text_block_list.text:
To be able to lay eyes upon you again this 
year, Lady Azuma... 
brings us such immense joy. 
Blessings upon you, blessings upon you...

text_block_list.name: Shuntaisai Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
We shall all do our utmost to make this 
year's festival wonderful. 
Lady Azuma, please watch over us all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. 
May this year's path be filled with 
happiness for you all.
choice_data_list: She really is... someone incredible, huh?

She really is... someone incredible, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we started going out together, 
I'd begun to feel 
closer to her, but seeing this scene 
reminded me once again.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You had no need to hold back; 
you could have simply called out to me.
choice_data_list: No, I actually liked watching from here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The people expressing their gratitude, and 
Azuma replying 
with such benevolence and warmth. 
Watching their exchanges warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The visitors have settled down now, 
so shall we step inside? 
I shall brew us some tea.
choice_data_list:
Ah, in that case, there's something I'd 
like to give you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After being welcomed inside, I handed over 
the souvenirs I brought: amazake and 
freshly pounded mochi.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This is... 
Thank you so very much for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Was this mochi pounded 
by you and <chrname> together?
choice_data_list: Yes, we took part in the shrine event.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Such softness, yet such resilient chew. 
This is truly an exquisitely prepared 
mochi.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It could never turn out like this without 
pounding 
it thoroughly, completely in sync with one 
another.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
One could say it stands as proof of the 
bond 
the two of you have forged over the past 
year.
choice_data_list:
Hearing you put it that way makes me a 
little shy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by her words, I reflected on the 
past year. 
Not everything was smooth sailing; 
there were times of hardship, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A year full of ups and downs. 
—Yet, together, we ran through it with 
everything we had.
choice_data_list:
It was tough at times, but it was a great 
year.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I, too, was well aware 
of your journey together.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: You have done exceedingly well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're still only midway on the road to our 
dream. 
I geared myself up to keep pushing forward 
alongside <chrname> even more this year.
choice_data_list:
I'm going to make this year shine even 
brighter!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Such an unyielding gaze... 
Truly, a wonderful resolution.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to offer a parting gift of 
my own.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—Is someone there? 
Please bring that item here.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text: Right away, Lady Azuma.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Here, these are celebratory sweets.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To mark the dawn of a brand-new year. 
Please accept them, if you would.
choice_data_list:
These look like they'd bring great 
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. 
They are merely a modest token.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yet I am certain they will help you 
greet the start of the year in good 
health.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—with both stomach and heart 
full, 
Azuma saw me off in a cozy, heartwarming 
atmosphere.
choice_data_list:
Once again, I look forward to working with 
you this year!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as do I. 
—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
There may be times this year when you lose 
your way. 
There may be days when you come to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Even so, as long as you and <chrname> 
walk this road together—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I shall pray from here that a wondrous 
sight 
awaits at the end of your journey.
choice_data_list: Please watch over us for another year...!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
I shall watch over the path you two forge 
this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—May your journey be blessed with great 
fortune.

title: Bonds with Azuma: In the New Year
